name: flyrank-ml-internship
title_zh: 13 个技能拼出一条从数据到部署的 ML 实习流水线
tagline_zh: 一个人做 ML 项目最怕的不是模型不收敛，是清洗、调参、写报告各用一套野路子。
tagline_en: Solo ML projects break at the seams: cleaning, tuning, and reporting each use their own ad-hoc approach. These 13.
why_zh: 按实习任务顺序编号，前一个的产物就是后一个的输入，不是 13 个各说各话的独立工具。
why_en: Numbered in internship-task order: each skill's output feeds the next, not 13 tools talking past each other.
limit_zh: 它是教学向的实习任务包，不是生产级 MLOps：没有实验追踪、没有 CI、没有模型监控，数据集也限定在仓库里那几个。
limit_en: A teaching-oriented internship pack, not production MLOps: no experiment tracking, CI, or model monitoring, and datasets are limited to the few in.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 13 skills chained into one data-to-deploy ML internship.
